mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only human rights treaty which affirms the reproductive rights of women and targets culture and tradition as influential forces shaping gender roles and family relations."
The Convention is the only human rights treaty which affirms the reproductive rights of women and targets culture and tradition as influential forces shaping gender roles and family relations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedure under the First Optional Protocol, ratified by in excess of 100 states."
More important is the procedure under the First Optional Protocol, ratified by in excess of 100 states.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the case in Africa where governments are always violently opposed to any assertion of a right to self-determination."
The reverse is the case in Africa where governments are always violently opposed to any assertion of a right to self-determination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the very real apprehension about the usefulness of litigation and adjudication as a method of dispute resolution."
More fundamental is the very real apprehension about the usefulness of litigation and adjudication as a method of dispute resolution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the least orthodox, but in its own terms very interesting with an approach that might be described as "continental"."
Cassese is the least orthodox, but in its own terms very interesting with an approach that might be described as "continental".

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the judicial organ of the United Nations and was the successor to the Permanent Court of International Justice (PCIJ), which was established in the aftermath of the First World War in 1921."

The ICJ is the judicial organ of the United Nations and was the successor to the Permanent Court of International Justice (PCIJ), which was established in the aftermath of the First World War in 1921.

The right to self-determination is a third generation right which is the collective or group rights.
